scope: Independent official-contract/source/public-aggregate analysis only; no individual gold/output causal attribution.

officialSources.supportedFact: Choice/score distribution and confidence are separate; application-labeled examples are needed for threshold selection.
officialSources.notEstablished: No calibrated correctness probability definition or equality with probability of CLEAR was found in the reviewed pages.

officialSources.supportedFact: Text input, supplied typed choice options, per-question instructions and ordered answer fields match current request/response paths; named refusals are a distinct answer type.

findings.conclusion: Confidence is a separate API output; treating it as P(CLEAR), a predicate probability,1-selectedProbability, or a calibrated correctness probability is unsupported. The code does none of those conversions.

Explicit uncertainty is MODEL_UNCERTAIN; otherwise confidence<configured threshold yields LOW_CONFIDENCE. TwoStage sends valid non-CLEAR results to B and refuses errors/refusal. Existing0.8 is diagnostic policy, not a vendor default or calibrated operating value.

One named choice question with three distinct string options, descriptions and full instructions receives the complete six-field participant/context JSON as a string. No label reversal, missing instruction placement or wrong JSON input type was identified.
findings.limitation: Actual16 request bodies deliberately not opened; custodian canonical integrity is separately relied on.

findings.conclusion: Raw9/16 and falseCLEAR6/8 remain failed prior gate; later B routing cannot erase them. Aggregate alone does not isolate model capability,prompt/task framing or gold validity.
findings.proof: Public aggregate only; individual gold review owned by custodian.

findings.conclusion: Raw correctCLEAR7 becomes CLEAR_STOP3 plus4low-confidence deferrals; plus1raw opposite review yields5unnecessary B routes. All8review-gold cases route B. This matches the implemented policy but does not prove an optimal threshold or any question-quality success.

Exact-key validation, sum tolerance1e-6 and selected-choice argmax are extra strict local policies whose full vendor guarantees were not established here. All16 parsed successfully, so these cannot explain this batch raw misclassification.
